description: Hi, I'm Harshini. I enjoy learning new concepts, exploring creative ideas, researching real-world problems, and developing technical solutions. I am excited to explore the untold stories of NASA's past missions through this challenge. I am interested in collaborating with people who have skills in programming, web development, UI/UX design, 3D modelling, animation, storytelling, and data visualization. I believe in learning together, sharing ideas, and creating something meaningful.
